_about: Similarity settings shared by self_contained_app.js (website) and vsae_contentbased.py (Streamlit). Edit here only. Deploy this file next to index.html.
_ppr_restart: Chance each step that the walk jumps back to the reference song (0-1). Higher = stays closer to direct matches.
_neighbor_share: How strongly neighbouring values connect (Baroque-Classical, Soprano-Mezzo), relative to how many songs each value has.
_rarity_damping: Beta (0-1). Each song-to-value link is scaled by (songs with that value)^beta. 0 = full IDF effect (rare values dominate), 1 = rarity ignored. 0.75 was chosen by checking reference songs.
